clarifications.title: Declare cross-field validator scope precisely without tightening legacy probe semantics
clarifications.detail: The old positive fixture includes status=ok and captured_bytes=0. The default nonnull parsed-core shape cannot satisfy the minimum byte count of a core at zero captured bytes. Explicitly authorize a shape-only fixture addition consistent with zero bytes and state whether legacy status=ok fixture permissiveness remains unchanged. If status=ok must itself prove a valid accepted version, this immutable old fixture has no solution. Minimum core and prefix byte-count feasibility, prefix empty iff captured bytes zero, vendor-prefix horizontal-space implications, tail empty/nonempty and charset/flag relations should be written as an exact finite relation table; metadata alone cannot prove the hidden invalid raw string.

clarifications.title: Make vendor-prefix core offset and decimal alphabet explicit
clarifications.detail: Specify that the exact 22-byte Docker Compose version prefix is classified at byte zero and core parsing begins immediately after it; numeric/v_numeric core parsing starts at byte zero. State ASCII [0-9] and maximal leading core match, so shell implementations and validator controls do not infer different offsets or suffix splits.
